_comment: Named UI regions for research/probes/uiassert.py, as fractions of the rekordbox window.
Fractional so they survive a resize; calibrated against
runs/CALIB/main.png (2050x1164) on 2026-08-14 in PERFORMANCE view.
STATE SEMANTICS:
greyed = control disabled. Dark grey glyphs, low peak brightness.
active = control enabled. Bright glyphs, high peak brightness.
The MIDI indicator and the MIX/LEVEL controls are the user-confirmed
tells for 'the controller is bound'. They are greyed in the baseline and
must go active on success. That is the milestone this whole project is
chasing, so it is asserted rather than eyeballed.
Thresholds are NOT absolute. uiassert.py calibrates per-screenshot against
the reference regions below, because rekordbox's skin, the compositor and
the display profile all shift absolute levels. A fixed number would rot.

reference._comment: Known-state regions used to calibrate the active/greyed split.

bright_text._comment: The 'File' menu label. Always enabled, always bright.

dark_background._comment: Empty panel below the library. Always dark, never has glyphs.

midi_indicator._comment: 'MIDI' top right. THE milestone tell: not greyed == controller bound.

pad_indicator._comment: 'PAD', immediately left of MIDI. Same enable path.

mix_control._comment: 'MIX' label + knob, above the library panel.

_comment: Click targets for the MAIN window.
FRAME WARNING, measured 2026-08-14: despite the header comment above,
these are fractions of the SPECTACLE SCREENSHOT (2050x1164), not of the
X window (1920x1006 at +0+28). `spectacle -a` captures the active window
plus KWin's drop shadow, so the window sits inset at +65+53 inside the
PNG. Verified with `magick ... -format %@` -> trimbox 1920x1034+65+53.
To turn one of these into a click, convert first:
screen_x = frac_x*2050 - 65 ; screen_y = frac_y*1164 - 53
The audio_prefs block below deliberately does NOT inherit this frame --
see its own comment.
Preferences -> Audio pane. Used by bin/audiotest.sh via
`research/probes/uiassert.py --block audio_prefs`.
WHAT THIS IS FOR: the Sample Rate dropdown silently went empty once
already (T03) and nobody noticed for a session. A headless probe cannot
catch it -- upstream/wasapitest.exe reports 48/48 exclusive formats
accepted while the dropdown is still blank, because rekordbox builds the
rate list at device-selection time on a path wasapitest never walks. So
the check has to read the real widget.
COORDINATE FRAME -- different from the main-window block above, on
purpose. The Preferences dialog is drawn with Wine's own titlebar and
gets NO KWin shadow, so `spectacle -a` returns exactly the X geometry:
trimbox == full frame). Fractions here are therefore fractions of the
dialog itself, and image px == window px == screen px + window origin.
Calibrated against runs/AUDIOTEST/03-audio.png (806x824).
HOW 'POPULATED' IS DECIDED: the combo interior is pure black (measured
peak=0.000 mean=0.000 sd=0.000 when empty), so any glyph at all lifts
both peak and spread hard. uiassert's existing 'absent' rule -- peak <
dark+0.06 AND sd < 0.03 -- separates the two states with an enormous
margin, so no new classifier was needed:
empty  (live, 2026-08-14)  peak=0.000 sd=0.000  -> absent
populated (synthetic white) peak=1.000 sd=0.269  -> active
populated (synthetic dim)   peak=0.471 sd=0.127  -> greyed
'greyed' still means glyphs are present, so audiotest.sh treats anything
that is not 'absent' as populated. Only 'absent' is the regression.
OCR WAS NOT USED FOR THE VERDICT. tesseract is installed and audiotest.sh
prints what it reads as commentary, but T00 already recorded OCR silently
returning nothing, which here would look exactly like an empty dropdown --
i.e. it would fake the very bug we are hunting. Pixels decide.
Both references live INSIDE the Audio pane, so the calibration is
immune to skin/compositor/display-profile drift and to the dialog
being partly occluded.
The Audio Device combo's value text ('DDJ-400 WASAPI'). This is the
in-shot POSITIVE CONTROL and it is load-bearing: it is the same
widget class, same skin, same font and same 6px text inset as the
Sample Rate combo, but it is known-populated (the bug is that the
device list still works while the rate list does not). If the
detector cannot see text HERE, it cannot be trusted to have seen the
absence of text below, and audiotest.sh raises a harness fault
instead of reporting a failure. x=224 is 6px inside the combo's left
edge at 218; y=118..134 spans the 13px glyph box at 120..131.
The RIGHT-HAND interior of the Sample Rate combo itself, x=430..630.
Deliberately the same widget and the same row as the region under
test rather than some other patch of panel: it is the combo's own
fill, so it tracks the combo's own background exactly. It stays
empty in both states -- a populated value reads '44100 Hz', ~70px,
which ends well before x=430 -- and the chevron sits at x~740, well
clear of the right edge at 630.
THE REGION UNDER TEST. The Sample Rate combo's value text area.
6px in from the left edge, 3px in from top and bottom so the 1px
border never contributes. 196px wide is ~2.8x the width of the
longest plausible value ('192000 Hz'), so a value cannot escape the
window horizontally.
absent == the regression. active/greyed == list has content.
Same box as reference.bright_text, graded as a region too so the
positive control appears in the report next to the region under
test. Reading these two side by side is the whole argument that a
FAIL is real and not a dead measurement.

audio_heading._comment: The bold 'Audio' section heading, x=190..260 y=82..100. Present only on this pane.

_comment: The bold 'Sample Rate' section heading, x=190..305 y=214..236.
NOT sufficient on its own as a pane check -- the View pane happens
to put a heading at the same y and it also reads 'active'. That is
why the sidebar-selection regions below exist.
PANE GATE, rows 1-6 of the left sidebar. Each box is the 10px icon
gutter at x=6..16 for that row, i.e. left of the label glyphs, so it
samples the selection fill and nothing else. Measured 2026-08-14:
selected row mean=0.297 peak=0.518 (blue highlight), every
unselected row mean=0.118 peak=0.118 sd=0.000 (flat panel grey).
audiotest.sh requires sidebar_sel_audio to be the brightest of the
six by a clear margin before it will grade anything.
WHY THIS IS NEEDED: on the View pane the Sample Rate combo's
coordinates land on flat panel (peak=0.118 sd=0.052), which is NOT
'absent' and would have been scored as populated. Without this gate
a mis-navigation would silently PASS -- the exact failure the test
exists to prevent. Row pitch is 33px from y=92 (PLAN).
Click targets, fractions of the PREFERENCES window (see frame note
above). screen_x = win_x + frac_x*win_w, screen_y = win_y + frac_y*win_h,
with win_* straight out of `xdotool getwindowgeometry`.

sidebar_view._c: 'View' row, (70,158). Used only to prove the click mapping.

tab_configuration._c: 'Configuration' tab, (206,40). The Audio pane lives under it.

sample_rate_combo._c: centre of the Sample Rate combo, (400,260).

_comment: THE ONLY SAFE WAY TO CLOSE THIS DIALOG. Click its titlebar X, which
Wine draws 12px in from the right edge and 11px down -- px, not a
fraction, because it is a fixed-size titlebar glyph.
DO NOT USE alt+F4. Measured 2026-08-14, one variable, 5 cycles each:
xdotool key --window <prefs> alt+F4 -> cycle 1 did nothing; cycle 2
closed the dialog and then REKORDBOX EXITED seconds later.
click this X                        -> 5/5 closed, app alive after
every one; then 6/6 clean end-to-end runs.
Every 'the gear click did not open Preferences' fault during
development was a later run finding the app already gone, killed by an
earlier alt+F4. The exit is graceful (WM_CLOSE, not a signal) so
settings are not at risk, but the test was destroying its own subject.
An UNtargeted alt+F4 is worse: it hits whatever holds focus, which
during development was the operator's terminal.
How to OPEN this dialog. Third coordinate frame, and it is neither of
the other two: offsets in PIXELS from the top-right of the main
window's X CLIENT rect (`xdotool getwindowgeometry`, 1920x1006 at
+0+28), i.e. screen_x = win_x + win_w - dx_from_right.
Pixels-from-the-right rather than a fraction because rekordbox's
toolbar is right-anchored with fixed-size icons: widen the window and
the gear keeps its distance from the right edge, while a fractional
anchor would drift off it. The existing top-level 'preferences_gear'
fraction is only correct at the one window size it was calibrated at.
Measured 2026-08-14: gear centre at screenshot px (1724,116) ->
The dialog size these fractions were calibrated at. audiotest.sh warns
if the live dialog differs, because every y here is top-anchored
layout rather than a true proportion -- a resized dialog would move
the combos relative to a fraction. The pane gate and the positive
control both fail loudly in that case, so the result is a fault, not a
wrong answer.
